data.name: Hamiyah
data.gender_notes: Hamiyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'hamee', meaning 'supporter' or 'helper'. In Islamic tradition, Hamiyah is a name given to a woman who is a faithful companion and supporter to her loved ones. The name Hamiyah carries the meaning “Companion, Supporter” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hamiyah usually hope their child will grow to embody companion, supporter and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hamiyah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
